reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new action and temporal motion—stepping off a night bus and realising a bag was left on board—which overrides the subject plate's static fighting stance and camera-facing pose.
reasons.medium: No explicit change of rendering medium is requested; the live-action reference remains authoritative for medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the observed charcoal technical jacket and worn black boots are retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: 'Night' and 'rain' are time-of-day and weather descriptions, not instructions about the light, an illuminating source, its direction or visible quality, so reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is requested; the 16:9 canvas ratio alone does not license a framing change, so reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; incidental night and rain wording does not authorize recoloring the scene, so reference palette governs.
